title: Refine Output trust workflow UI
summary: Refined the WebView Output tab trust workflow with clearer Pending Publish labeling, Overview trust decisions, durable missing-output placement labels, Advanced proof grouping, and distinct command vs read-only evidence surfaces.
reason: Operators needed to distinguish current completed outputs, historical/missing output evidence, and parked-output drain work without guessing whether a row was safe to trust, review, rerun, or investigate.
behavior_before: The Output tab used a generic Publish subtab label, hid important trust warnings mostly in dense evidence panels, used Acceptance Checklist wording that could imply a backend state change, and did not classify missing historical outputs by pending/drain proof posture in the main History table.
behavior_after: The Output tab labels parked-output work as Pending Publish, shows an Overview-level Output Trust Decision summary, classifies History rows as Current or missing with pending/drain/no/unknown proof, groups Advanced evidence by proof domain, and labels promotion/drain command areas separately from read-only evidence.

rollback_plan: Revert the touched WebView partial/static asset/test changes and remove this change packet; no backend command, schema, media policy, or filesystem mutation behavior was changed.
notes: Implemented Output trust decision, Pending Publish drain summary, durable placement labels, and acceptance readiness copy. Validation blockers recorded above are outside this Output trust workflow scope.
